cite.name: Robert Lowth
cite.why: A Bishop of London who holds the sacred writings justly attributed to the inspiration of the Holy Spirit; each cite names its work and printed page.

cite.name: Jebb's Sacred Literature
cite.why: Jebb calls the New Testament's writers inspired and Scripture the lively oracles of God, and sets out the Bible's parallel lines as they stand.

cite.name: Thomas Boys
cite.why: An Anglican Hebrew scholar who holds that the words of the Spirit are delivered in an order of their own, and sets out that order in the text.

cite.name: Forbes's Symmetrical Structure of Scripture
cite.why: Forbes holds that Scripture claims plenary inspiration for itself and answers those who allege mistakes in it; he reads its ordered structure as the work of a God of order.
